DeckPilot 1.9.9 starts the independent DeckPilot release channel. DeckPilot releases use `v1.9.x` tags and contain only the desktop app, installer, portable package and firmware bundle. Atelier is published separately.

The in-app updater selects stable `vX.Y.Z` releases, so Atelier versions cannot be mistaken for DeckPilot updates.
